notes: Per-page fair-share concurrency for 24/7 servicing: each page can be given a guaranteed slice of the Max Concurrent Browser Windows cap so one busy page can no longer starve another, with graceful (non-forceful) handback as windows finish. AI content generation is now serialized per polling browser so concurrently-arriving posts don't race each other on it. Account selection for react/comment/share now prefers whichever account's Last Interact is oldest instead of picking uniformly at random, spreading usage evenly across the fleet.
